audit_metadata.title: CM3070 Final Architecture Pre-Integration Audit
audit_metadata.project: AI-Driven Football Tactical Analysis and Training Evaluation System
audit_metadata.primary_product_workspace: d:\Final project videos transcripts\AI-Driven Football Tactical Analysis and Training Evaluation System

duplication_analysis.frontend: Research workspace contains obsolete 3-file static prototype (index.html, index.css, app.js). Primary workspace contains modern TanStack Start SSR application.
duplication_analysis.backend: Research workspace contains monolithic server.py prototype. Primary workspace contains modular FastAPI control plane.
duplication_analysis.pipeline: Research workspace contains operational pipeline scripts (asr.py, homography.py, fusion.py, validator.py, reporter.py). Primary workspace contains stub interfaces raising NotImplementedError.

reconciliation_required: Update backend/app/core/model_manifest.yaml to replace stale qwen3:8b reference with frozen llama3.1:8b (digest 46e0c10c... and prompt SHA ab95a835...).
Wire frontend/tactical-ai-insights-main/src/routes/showcase.tsx to consume backend /api/v1/showcase endpoint instead of static constants.
Port and adapt research pipeline modules into primary backend/app/pipeline/ once Vision selection is frozen.

frontend.framework: React 19.0.0 + TanStack Start 1.170.18 + Vite 8.1.5 + Tailwind CSS 4.2.1

storage_and_media_validation.storage_provider: Supabase Storage (private buckets: raw-videos, audio-extractions, artifacts)

modal_compute.role: Control plane smoke test and callback verification

vision_subsystem.detector_implementation: IMPLEMENTED (Stage 4B fine-tuned YOLO11m, best.pt, SHA-256 f6b3fe6f..., 3 horizontal tiles, 15% overlap, global NMS IoU 0.70)

gap_register.description: Primary workspace backend/app/pipeline/ stubs raise NotImplementedError and MethodologyExecutorRegistry blocks dispatch with HTTP 409.
gap_register.remediation: Port and adapt tested pipeline modules from research workspace (asr.py, homography.py, fusion.py, validator.py, reporter.py) into primary backend.

gap_register.description: Final tracker/identity selection among M1, M2, and M3 awaits human dense-GT annotation and TrackEval scoring on 4 challenge clips.
gap_register.remediation: Complete dense-GT TrackEval benchmark, record winning method, and integrate its tracker into backend/app/pipeline/tracking.py.

gap_register.description: modal_app/worker.py is a CPU smoke harness and does not run AI models.
gap_register.remediation: Configure Modal container with GPU, dependencies, and pipeline execution script.

gap_register.description: backend/app/core/model_manifest.yaml references qwen3:8b instead of frozen llama3.1:8b.
gap_register.remediation: Update model_manifest.yaml with llama3.1:8b digest 46e0c10c... and system prompt SHA-256 ab95a835....

gap_register.description: frontend/tactical-ai-insights-main/src/routes/showcase.tsx uses hardcoded static cards rather than calling /api/v1/showcase.
gap_register.remediation: Wire showcase.tsx to fetch from /api/v1/showcase and render golden media.

gap_register.description: Local development environment is running Python 3.8.10, whereas contracts and Modal specify Python >= 3.10.
gap_register.remediation: Standardize local development virtual environment to Python 3.10+.

gap_register.description: Preview routes /analysis/processing and /results remain in build.
gap_register.remediation: Cleanly deprecate or redirect preview routes.

gap_register.description: System runs in single-tenant dev mode without Supabase Auth UI.
gap_register.remediation: Implement login/signup and JWT verification in production release.

critical_questions_assessment.5_ai_orchestration_real_or_mocked: Stubbed with fail-closed safeguards in primary product; 100% real and tested in secondary research workspace.
critical_questions_assessment.8_vision_production_slot: VISION_METHOD_PENDING_FINAL_EVALUATION_SELECTION (Stage 4B YOLO11m detector implemented; tracker pending dense-GT evaluation).
critical_questions_assessment.9_exact_work_remaining_after_vision_sele: Port research pipeline modules into primary backend/app/pipeline/, update model manifest, configure Modal worker container with GPU/dependencies, and wire frontend showcase route.
critical_questions_assessment.10_effort_classification: MEDIUM_INTEGRATION_TASK (Estimated 3 to 5 engineering days; NOT a major rebuild).
